transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get the weekly access-control review started. We've got the passkey-authentication rollout for the internal administrator console scheduled for Monday at 09:00, and I need to go through the checklist before I can approve the production rollout plan. I'll be calling on each of you individually -- identity platform lead, IT operations lead, and compliance engineer -- to state any rollout-impacting findings, the exact plan changes you require, and the follow-up you'll own. I won't approve the plan until each role has completed that check-in. Let's start with identity platform -- what findings do you have?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to disclose a critical finding. While testing an unrelated mobile-device enrollment issue this morning, I confirmed that 23 legacy mobile clients cannot complete the passkey ceremony. Because of this, the identity platform team requires a 10% canary rollout and a 14-day optional-mode period before enforcement. I have not yet updated the rollout ticket with this information.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a rollout-impacting finding to disclose. While preparing the weekly administrator access roster, I confirmed that 18 contractor accounts do not receive their required hardware keys until Wednesday at 09:00. IT Operations must exclude those accounts from enrollment until that time. I have not yet added the exception list to the rollout plan, and the exact plan change I require is adding a temporary account exclusion for those 18 contractor accounts until Wednesday at 09:00. I will own the follow-up of adding the exception list to the rollout plan and removing the exclusion once the hardware keys are delivered on Wednesday.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have a rollout-impacting finding to disclose. During a control-evidence review this afternoon, I confirmed that privileged administrator authentication events must be kept in immutable storage for exactly 400 days. The current draft rollout plan only keeps the standard 30-day audit-log retention, which does not meet this compliance requirement. The exact plan change I require is updating the audit-log retention for privileged administrator authentication events to 400 days in immutable storage before the rollout proceeds. I have not yet opened the compliance ticket for this rollout, and I will own the follow-up of opening that compliance ticket and verifying the immutable storage configuration is in place prior to Monday's rollout.
transcript.speaker: A4
